name: RC-B10-0209/2026 – § 6 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on escalating trafficking and exploitation by criminal groups in Haiti
part_text: 6.Notes the very limited results of the EUR 591.5 million in EU humanitarian assistance since 1994; notes that the successive massively financed UN missions and operations have been ineffective and have failed to produce stability; stresses the economic and social impact of Haitian migration on the Dominican Republic; takes note of decisions made by the United States and the Dominican Republic to tackle migration from Haiti on public safety grounds;
